environment.description: Same Kafka consumer on EKS (v1.28) in us-east-1. The Confluent REST Proxy is fronted by an internal NLB (scheme: internal) with a VPC endpoint service. Producers connect through AWS PrivateLink. Additionally, the NLB target group has a security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) with inbound rules restricted to three CIDR blocks: 10.0.0.0/8 (internal VPC), 172.16.0.0/12 (peered VPCs from CI/CD), and 192.168.100.0/24 (on-prem producer subnet via Direct Connect). The EKS cluster's pod security admission is set to 'restricted' profile. A NetworkPolicy (Calico) on the consumer namespace only allows ingress from the kafka-system namespace on port 9092. The Kafka cluster itself uses mTLS for inter-broker and client authentication (ACLs require CN=producer-svc for WRITE on user-events topic).

config.privatelink: enabled, VPC endpoint service for REST proxy
config.kafka_auth: mTLS with ACL (CN=producer-svc required for WRITE)
config.network_policy: Calico, ingress from kafka-system namespace only
